Implement the following requested change in the repository.

[ElastiCache] createUser should map engine to be lowercase
In boto3, I created two Elasticache Redis users and noticed that the engine value for users get stored in lowercase. May need to adapt moto to store the passed values in lowercase.

Create with lowercase
```
import boto3
client = boto3.client('elasticache')
client.create_user(UserId="user1", UserName="user1", Engine = "redis", AccessString = " on ~* +@all", AuthenticationMode = { 'Type': 'iam' },)

```

result:
```
{'UserId': 'user1', 'UserName': 'user1', 'Status': 'active', 'Engine': 'redis', ...}
```

Create with upper case
```
client.create_user(UserId="user2", UserName="user2", Engine = "Redis", AccessString = " on ~* +@all", AuthenticationMode = { 'Type': 'iam' },)
```

result:
```
{'UserId': 'user2', 'UserName': 'user2', 'Status': 'active', 'Engine': 'redis', ...}
```

Looking at the [Elasticache User API docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/aws-resource-elasticache-user.html#cfn-elasticache-user-engine), the values accepted are `'valkey'` or `'redis'`

Scope of this editing session: update the following production files and report the resulting local change for handover: moto/elasticache/models.py. No full task validation has been performed in this session.
